texto_dialectal: ¡Qué bueno, está brutal la fiesta que armó el grupo de bachata!
traduccion_referencia: The party the bachata group threw is absolutely amazing!
traduccion_modelo_sin_ajustar: How great, the bachata group did a fantastic party!

texto_dialectal: Mira, la vista desde la cima está brutal, no me lo puedo creer.
traduccion_referencia: Look, the view from the top is amazing, I can't believe it.
traduccion_modelo_sin_ajustar: The view from the top is brutal, I can't believe it.

texto_dialectal: Che, estoy remando con el sueldo que me dan.
traduccion_referencia: Dude, I'm barely getting by with the paycheck I get.
traduccion_modelo_sin_ajustar: Oh, I am rowing with the salary they give me.

texto_dialectal: ¡Qué quilombo! Yo sigo remando con este salario, pero no llega.
traduccion_referencia: What a mess! I'm still getting by with this salary, but it's not enough.
traduccion_modelo_sin_ajustar: What a mess! I keep rowing with this salary, but it doesn't come.

texto_dialectal: ¡Neta! Si eso pasa, no lo creo.
traduccion_referencia: Seriously! If that happens, I don't believe it.
traduccion_modelo_sin_ajustar: Surely! If that happens, I don't believe it.
